title: Nigeria confirms Ebola case linked to East Africa
text: Nigeria confirmed an Ebola case in a woman who travelled from Uganda to Abuja. The diagnosis was confirmed by laboratory tests. The patient was isolated and received medical care. Authorities identified 44 close contacts and began contact tracing.

title: Ebola has spread from Congo to 4 other countries. A look at where things stand
text: The outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo and spread to other countries. Nigeria reported a case involving a woman who travelled from Uganda. Uganda reported no active cases, while Kenya reported nine cases linked to one patient. France also recorded a case involving a doctor returning from Congo. The outbreak raised concerns about surveillance and cross-border transmission.

title: Nigeria reports Ebola case, fourth African country affected by outbreak
text: Nigeria reported its first Ebola case in more than a decade. Authorities identified 44 contacts and began tracing them. The delayed diagnosis raised concerns about possible exposure. Officials emphasized surveillance and regional coordination. Uganda reported no active cases, while Kenya reported nine cases linked to one patient.

title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
event: Russia-Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi
text: Two days of talks between Russia, Ukraine and the United States in Abu Dhabi ended without a major breakthrough on ending the war. Discussions focused on post-war security arrangements and Europe's role in future negotiations. The parties indicated that progress had been made, including on a possible prisoner exchange, but major disagreements remained.

title: Trump envoys to meet Putin in Moscow after latest Ukraine talks end with no breakthrough
event: Russia-Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi
text: After two days of talks in Abu Dhabi between Russian, Ukrainian and American negotiators, US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff announced plans to travel to Moscow to meet Vladimir Putin. The negotiations ended without a clear breakthrough. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky described an important humanitarian agreement on a prisoner exchange, while security guarantees were also discussed. Significant differences between Russia and Ukraine remained.

title: Russia, Ukraine reach deal on prisoner swap as US says lack of trust holds back talks
event: Russia-Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi
text: Russian and Ukrainian negotiators agreed in principle to a major prisoner exchange after two days of US-brokered talks in Abu Dhabi. However, major disagreements remained, especially over territory. US envoy Jared Kushner said a lack of trust between the sides continued to make negotiations difficult.
